第 1651章 您的背后（第1页）
“陛下，诸世文明、生灵、种族俱是一家，我们都属于净土，共面浊世大敌。”
“既然来了，都是战友，为你们讲解情况，也是为我们的援军讲解情况，将来便可以缓解前线诸军的压力，这是应该的。”
在接到天主圣皇的命令后，他便知道，眼前的这位超脱帝主，恐怕在将来，便是整个超脱之上所有文明和军团的最高统帅了。
伟大的圣皇高悬于太初空，所有人的最强者，便是长衡仙帝。
艾罗·塔伦便挥了挥手，让身后的军团战士们融入仙庭的队列中。
他们将分成很多个单位，尽量为所有人解答超脱之上的情况，以及曾经在这里发生过的历史。
当然，还要告知他们注意游荡在元始神山的那头危险的初王无头身。
当然，这个主要是讲给长衡仙帝听的。
不过，在艾罗·塔伦看来，这位仙帝陛下听说了这具初王无头身后，便目视洞穿帷幕，看向那具初王无头身。
年轻的繁星军团统帅，突然在仙庭诸军中，发现了白空天使诺薇达莉等人。
包括号称最后的天使的露娜·安温尔。
整个繁星文明都掀起了一波悲伤的浪潮。
他们甚至以为，这辈子都难以看到除了太初空上那位伟岸陛下以外的天使了。
没想到，在这一次长衡仙帝率领的超脱者队列里看到了。
在他身边，长衡仙帝见他神情，笑道。
“你没看错，她们的确是天使一族，为首的那位诺薇达莉，甚至拥有圣皇血脉。”
“那恐怕，这位女天使，如今是太初空上，那位白金君王在超脱之上的最后血脉了。”

“长衡仙帝陛下，我是否可以和那位天使军团长交谈一番。”
“当然，我这就通知她来到我们的身边。”
曾经的露娜·安温尔，也帮了他大忙。
否则，如今站在超脱之上的超脱帝主，恐怕就是另一个人了。
她先恭敬地朝着长衡仙帝行了一个天使礼仪。
长衡仙帝直入主题，指着艾罗·达伦说道。
“这位是艾罗·达伦，繁星文明第三守墓人军团的军团长。他们来这里，是来指引我们的。”
“很高兴见到你，艾罗·塔伦阁下。”
“不，我们才是很荣幸见到您，诺薇达莉殿下！”
“请让我们对您表达最崇高的敬意！”
他郑重行礼，让诺薇达莉有些不知所措。
“你…你们这是在做什么，我值得吗？”
“您值得，因为您的背后，站着整个天使一族！”

Chapter 1651 Behind You (Page 1)
"Your Majesty, the civilizations, creatures, and races of all worlds are all one family. We all belong to the Pure Land and we face the enemy of the troubled world together."
"Now that we are here, we are all comrades. I will explain the situation to you and our reinforcements. In the future, we can relieve the pressure on the frontline troops. This is what we should do."
After receiving the order from the Holy Emperor of God, he knew that the Transcendent Emperor in front of him would probably be the supreme commander of all civilizations and legions above Transcendence in the future.
The great Holy Emperor hangs high in the sky of Taichu, and the strongest among all is the Immortal Emperor Changheng.
Aero Talen waved his hand, letting the legion soldiers behind him merge into the queue of the Immortal Court.
They will be divided into many units and try to explain to everyone the situation above transcendence and the history that happened here.
Of course, they must also be told to pay attention to the dangerous headless body of the First King wandering in the Yuanshi Mountain.
Of course, this is mainly for Immortal Emperor Changheng.
However, in Arrow Talon's opinion, when the Immortal Emperor heard about the headless body of the First King, he looked through the curtain and looked at the headless body of the First King.
The young commander of the Star Army suddenly discovered the White Sky Angel Novidali and others among the armies of the Immortal Court.
Including Luna Anwin, known as the last angel.
A wave of sadness set off across the entire starry civilization.
They even thought that it would be difficult to see an angel other than the majestic Majesty in the sky in the beginning of their lives.
Unexpectedly, I saw it in the queue of detached people led by Immortal Emperor Chang Heng this time.
Beside him, Immortal Emperor Changheng saw his expression and smiled.
"You read that right, they are indeed a clan of angels, and the leader, Novidali, even has the blood of the Holy Emperor."
"Then I'm afraid, this female angel is now the last bloodline of the platinum king in Taichu Kong who is above transcendence."
"Your Majesty the Immortal Emperor Chang Heng, can I have a chat with the Angel Legion Commander?"
"Of course, I will notify her to come to us right now."
The former Luna Anwen also helped him a lot.
Otherwise, the Transcendent Emperor who stands on Transcendence now may be another person.
She first respectfully performed an angelic ritual toward Immortal Emperor Chang Heng.
Immortal Emperor Chang Heng went straight to the point and pointed at Airl Darren.
"This is Aero Darren, the commander of the Third Gravekeeper Legion of the Starry Civilization. They are here to guide us."
"Nice to meet you, Lord Aero Talon."
"No, we are honored to meet you, Your Highness Novidali!"
"Please allow us to express our highest respect for you!"
He saluted solemnly, leaving Novidali a little at a loss.
"You...what are you doing? Am I worth it?"
"You are worth it, because behind you, there is an entire family of angels!"
